ac8de685f11d1b05.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة يونايتد هامات عن محامٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى المحامي في هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة القضايا، إعداد ملفاتها، وجمع البينات والأدلة اللازمة. كما يشمل الدور تمثيل الموكلين أمام المحاكم والجهات المختلفة، وصياغة العقود والاتفاقيات القانونية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال القضايا وتحديد نوعها، وتحليل عناصرها، وتقديم الرأي القانوني بشأنها. تحديد وجمع البينات الخطية (الوثائق والمستندات) والشخصية (شهود الدفاع والإثبات) وأدلة الإثبات ذات الصلة. كتابة لوائح الدعوى وتحضير حافظات المستندات الخاصة بها. مراجعة المحاكم المختصة لتقديم لوائح الدعوى ومتابعة تبليغ المدعى عليه. حضور الجلسات المحددة من قبل المحكمة، ومناقشة الشهود، وتقديم المرافعة، ومتابعة القضية حتى صدور الحكم. تمثيل الموكلين (مدعين أو مدعى عليهم) لدى مختلف درجات المحاكم، وجميع اللجان والمجالس الرسمية، والمحكمين. تقديم المدافعة والمرافعة والإنذارات العدلية والعادية والاعتراضات والمطالبات للموكلين. المفاوضة بشأن العقود والاتفاقيات مع جميع الجهات الرسمية وغير الرسمية. صياغة العقود والاتفاقيات وتوثيقها لدى الجهات ذات العلاقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمحاماة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المحاماة. القدرة على دراسة القضايا وتحليلها بشكل دقيق. مهارات ممتازة في صياغة المستندات القانونية والعقود. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في البحث وجمع الأدلة. القدرة على المرافعة والتمثيل القانوني الفعال. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على تنظيم وتوثيق المستندات القانونية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق عمل شركة يونايتد هامات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

ac93504c1d17c99f.description: About Insulet and the Role Insulet is seeking a Clinical Training Lead (Field) for a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role focuses on integrating advanced technology with a clear purpose: to provide user-friendly solutions for individuals with diabetes. The Clinical Training Lead will support the Saudi Arabia market, with potential for expansion across the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region. Role Purpose and Impact The primary objective of this position is to support commercial plans and accelerate patient acquisition and retention. This is achieved by ensuring excellence in training for sales teams, educators, and healthcare professionals (HCPs), as well as through the effective delivery and tracking of programs. The role is crucial for enhancing the knowledge of distributor partner staff, identifying areas for improvement, and sharing best practices to improve understanding and communication of the Omnipod portfolio's benefits. Close collaboration with external healthcare professionals to support training opportunities is also a key aspect. Key Responsibilities Conduct training needs assessments with distributor partner personnel, then design and deliver relevant training courses and materials to ensure effective product launch and ongoing clinical excellence. Provide onboarding training for new team members to optimize the patient and HCP experience for the Omnipod portfolio. Collaborate with the Country Manager and cross-functional teams to build knowledge, support capability development, and achieve training objectives. Offer comprehensive support to distributor partner personnel for Omnipod Discover (Data Management Platform), including account setup, report generation, user training, and best-practice implementation to maximize adoption and utilization among HCPs and patients. Develop training materials for delivery to distributor partner clinical and sales teams, utilizing the Veeva Medical Review (MLR) framework for content approval. Training on this framework will be provided. Assist with training events such as pump clinics, pump support groups, patient group and virtual training info sessions, educational events, product training, and workshops at local conferences. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree or demonstrable experience in training and/or managing insulin pump patients. 5-10 years of demonstrable experience in a medical device or pharmaceutical organization in a commercial role (clinical/sales/marketing/training). Essential experience in diabetes. Certified Diabetes Educator (CDE) is strongly preferred. A background in Nursing or Clinical Services is preferable. Prior commercial experience is strongly preferred. Sales / Clinical Training Experience or experience working with Channel Partners is an advantage. Travel Requirements This role requires frequent travel across the Middle East region, up to 30% of the time.

aca97b153718586f.description: About Almarai Founded in 1977, Almarai Company is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and the largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai is ranked as the number one FMCG Brand in MENA and holds market leadership across all its categories in the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. With over five decades of sustained growth, Almarai has consistently delivered nutritious and healthy products, guided by its principle: “Quality you can trust.” Almarai’s product portfolio has expanded beyond dairy to include juices and beverages, baked goods, poultry, infant formula, dates, fish and seafood, and bottled water, marketed under more than 20 brands such as Almarai, L’usine, 7DAYS, ALYOUM, Nuralac, Farm’s Select, Ice Leaf, Almira, Seama, Oska, IVAL, Almara Pro, Premier Chef, and Bakemart. The company currently employs over 43,000 Quality Makers across the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. In 2025, Almarai reported a net income of SAR billion on sales of SAR 22 billion. Role Overview Almarai is seeking a Senior Laboratory Supervisor to join its team in Hail. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the availability of updated, timely, and accurate information and data regarding analysis and testing results, from birds in process to finished products. Key Responsibilities Ensure the availability of updated, timely, and accurate information and data. Manage documentation related to analysis and testing results. Oversee testing processes for products, from raw materials (birds on process) to finished goods. Maintain the integrity and accuracy of all laboratory data and records. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a laboratory supervision or similar role. Demonstrated ability to manage data and documentation effectively. Experience in quality control or assurance within a food and beverage manufacturing environment is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Hail. The role offers an opportunity to contribute to a global business known for its commitment to quality and expansion. Compensation Compensation for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

ac4209ba0c2ede4b.description: This is a unique opportunity to shape a major residential portfolio at a formative stage, not just manage what has already been decided. The role offers real influence over product, strategy and development direction, within a business that is building something long-term and high-profile. It is a senior client-side development role focused on villas and townhouses. You will lead projects through the critical early and mid development stages, from development brief, feasibility and product definition through design management, approvals, procurement strategy and delivery readiness. This is for you if a true developer mindset: commercially minded, comfortable challenging assumptions, and able to balance product, market, design, cost and program. You will work closely with internal teams and external consultants and you will need the credibility and confidence to represent the business effectively in complex stakeholder environments. (!) This is not a pure project management, pure design or construction delivery role. About Qiddiya Residential Qiddiya’s Residential Business Unit is creating new neighborhoods within one of Saudi Arabia’s most ambitious destination-led developments. The focus is not simply to build housing, but to shape high-quality, market-relevant communities that support a long-term residential vision. Within that context, the Villas & Townhouses team is a key part of the product strategy. We are looking for a senior development leader who can help shape, challenge and drive the development of this portfolio from the front end; ensuring projects are commercially sound, well positioned and set up for successful delivery. Key responsibilities Lead a portfolio of development projects from feasibility through delivery readiness Define product strategy, unit mix, phasing and development briefs Drive feasibility, business planning and commercial optimisation Manage design, consultants, approvals and procurement strategy Represent the business in key stakeholder discussions Improve development processes across the portfolio Strong client-side residential development experience Proven capability across feasibility, product definition, design management and commercial decision-making A true developer mindset, not just project management Ability to balance product, design, cost, programme and profitability Strong stakeholder management across consultants, authorities and senior leadership Middle East experience preferred Developer backgrounds preferred over pure consultancy, contractor or PMC Relevant degree required; real estate or commercial qualifications are a plus

ac28eb6ba8bbfa1f.description: About the Role Yanbu Aramco Sinopec Refining Company (YASREF) Ltd. is seeking a Fire Chief II to lead firefighting and emergency response teams in Al Madinah, specifically in Yanbu and Medina. This full-time role involves commanding emergency operations, managing day-to-day shift operations, and ensuring meticulous fire protection. The Fire Chief II will also ensure compliance with all government regulations related to fire safety. Key Responsibilities Lead firefighting and emergency response teams and command emergency operations, including managing shifts, scheduling, and administering duties. Conduct risk assessment inspections and visit premises to identify hazards and develop mitigation plans. Inspect buildings for hazardous conditions and fire code violations, such as combustible material accumulation, electrical wiring issues, and inadequate fire exits. Follow up on fire code compliance to ensure corrective actions are taken for identified violations. Ensure technical specifications for firefighting equipment (fire trucks, foam/water carriers, emergency vehicles, rescue equipment, advance control vehicles, and portable equipment) are maintained. Inspect properties handling hazardous materials to ensure compliance with laws, codes, and regulations, and issue permits to compliant facilities. Ensure proper firefighting and emergency response techniques are applied, responding safely and promptly to emergencies such as fires, toxic leaks, gas leaks, and rescue operations. Conduct regular training to update knowledge of fire prevention, safety, and firefighting procedures, and plan and evaluate training for YASREF volunteers and the Emergency Response Team (ERT). Provide mentorship and development within the department, coaching and developing colleagues. Plan and conduct annual theoretical and practical fire extinguisher training for YASREF employees. Stay updated on new firefighting/emergency response technology and ensure techniques, equipment, and training align with best practices. Participate in plans for new or remodeled buildings to ensure structures meet fire safety codes, reviewing drawings for new developments and recommending fire protection systems. Conduct internal investigations to determine negligence and violations by fire department employees. Develop and coordinate fire prevention programs, including false alarm billing, fire inspection reporting, and hazardous materials management. Relay work orders, messages, or information to or from work crews, supervisors, or field inspectors using telephones or two-way radios. Examine fire sites, collect evidence, and accelerant residue to determine fire causes. Participate in communication and coordination meetings with internal and external agencies, coordinate emergency drills, and work with local fire departments. Ensure all government regulations related to fire safety are followed and implemented, providing aid in emergency mitigation as directed by supervisory personnel or outside agencies when required. Perform other job-related duties as assigned by the direct Supervisor. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Fire Protection, or an equivalent field. Certified in Fire Protection. A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Internal and External Communication The role requires regular internal reporting and referral to hierarchy, implementing pertinent policies, exchanging information, and discussing relevant KPIs/performance parameters. The Fire Chief II will also provide services to other organizations within YASREF.

ac5da26bfce7fd68.description: About the Role Emerson is seeking a Cybersecurity Service Engineer to provide technical service, maintenance, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and cybersecurity support for Emerson products and solutions in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role serves as a key point of contact for customer technical support, service contracts, projects, and cybersecurity initiatives. The engineer will help customers enhance system performance, reliability, and cybersecurity posture through proactive recommendations and technical expertise. Key Responsibilities Perform routine maintenance and service activities in accordance with customer requirements. Provide recommendations to customers on system improvements, cybersecurity enhancements, product upgrades, and system health checks. Coordinate and execute assigned service projects and technical activities. Perform startup, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, fault analysis, and repair activities on Emerson systems and products. Investigate and resolve technical issues encountered at customer sites. Support Sales Engineers in product demonstrations and customer presentations. Assist customers in understanding product applications, cybersecurity best practices, maintenance requirements, and operational procedures. Develop and implement system configuration changes to meet customer requirements. Deliver customer training and on-site instruction related to operation, maintenance, and cybersecurity solutions. Participate in on-call support rotations as required. Maintain accurate service documentation, timesheets, site reports, and project records. Ensure compliance with Emerson business processes, quality standards, and customer requirements. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience and demonstrate a strong commitment to customer service. This role requires an individual who is adept at problem-solving and capable of effective communication with both customers and internal teams. The candidate should also be proactive in developing technical expertise and adapting to new technologies. Required Skills and Attributes Customer-focused approach with a commitment to delivering exceptional service. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for resolving complex technical issues. Effective communication skills for interacting with customers and internal stakeholders. A continuous learning mindset to develop technical expertise and adapt to evolving technologies. Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and maintain professionalism in challenging situations. Capability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and functions. Emerson's Commitment to Employees Emerson fosters a workplace where employees are valued, respected, and empowered. The company promotes an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives. Emerson is dedicated to ongoing career development, offering support through mentorship, training, and leadership opportunities. The company also prioritizes employee wellbeing, providing flexible and competitive benefits plans that address physical, mental, financial, and social needs. These include medical insurance, an Employee Assistance Program, tuition reimbursement, and various recognition programs. A culture that values work-life balance is supported through flexible time-off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation, and holiday leave. Training programs focus on end-to-end development, from onboarding through senior leadership, with opportunities such as face-to-face and virtual training, coaching, project management, and on-the-job training.

ac62475e5650dcea.description: About Yokogawa Yokogawa is a prominent provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems, and industrial services across various industries. The company has received awards for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards. Yokogawa is committed to supporting the energy transition, biotechnology, artificial intelligence, and industrial cybersecurity, aligning with the United Nations sustainable development goals through its capabilities in measurement and connection. The Role of Lab Administrator Yokogawa is seeking a Lab Administrator to join its team in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and involves managing laboratory operations, documentation, and project administration. The role is integral to supporting the company's commitment to technology and planetary care, working within a global culture that values respect, collaboration, and integrity. Key Responsibilities Receive approved customer orders from Sales and establish new project files within the company's document management system. Translate engineering Bill of Materials (BOMs) into purchase requisitions for specialized GC hardware, columns, and calibration gas standards. Track component delivery schedules, identify long-lead items, and coordinate with the Operations Manager to align material availability with lab assembly timelines. Serve as the primary administrative contact for external client logistics teams and internal sales management. Assemble, organize, and format final customer documentation, including technical test reports, peak chromatograms, tuning sheets, and calibration records. Compile component traceabilities, material test certificates (MTRs), hazardous area compliance certificates (ATEX, IECEx, UL), and Certificate of Origin documents. Maintain centralized digital and physical archives of standard operating procedures (SOPs), application notes, and project revision histories. Manage general laboratory administration, including consumables inventory management (carrier gases, calibration cylinders, tubings, fittings, ferrules, lab supplies). Coordinate customer visits for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), managing visitor access, logistics, meeting schedules, and sign-off documentation. Oversee routine lab calibration equipment maintenance schedules and third-party tool certification records. Required Competencies Rigorous Organization: Demonstrated attention to detail in tracking multi-item project BOMs and organizing technical document packages accurately. Proactive Communication: Ability to coordinate effectively across cross-functional teams, including Proposal Engineers, Technicians, Managers, and Customers. Multitasking Agility: Capacity to balance routine laboratory administration duties with urgent project order processing demands. Experience and Work Environment Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, and offers opportunities for professional growth within a global company culture that emphasizes respect, value creation, and collaboration.

ac7295f86462c6ce.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن دار العلوم للتربية والتعليم عن حاجتها لمدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تأسيس وقيادة مكتب إدارة مشاريع (PMO) فعال على مستوى الجامعة، ليكون جزءاً لا يتجزأ من العمليات المركزية. يعتبر هذا المنصب محورياً في إنجاز برنامج تحول مؤسسي ضخم، ويدعم أجندة النمو الاستراتيجي للجامعة وأهداف خلق القيمة على المدى الطويل، بما في ذلك الاعتماد الدولي وتطوير الحرم الجامعي والتميز التشغيلي. يرفع شاغل الوظيفة تقاريره إلى مكتب الرئيس التنفيذي، وسيعمل في صميم البرنامج لتنسيق مسارات العمل متعددة التخصصات، والحفاظ على معايير الحوكمة، وضمان المساءلة عن الإنجاز عبر مجموعة من المبادرات الاستراتيجية. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة، وهي بدوام كامل. المهام الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات تطوير وتنفيذ المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات. ضمان توفير الموارد في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المحددة. تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد. تحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطط اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة الجودة. إدارة عمليات التغيير بناءً على الخطط الموضوعة. متابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم تحقيق الأهداف. ضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء بشكل دوري. رفع التقارير للإدارة العليا والأطراف المعنية. المسؤوليات الأساسية بناء وإدارة محفظة متكاملة ومرتبة حسب الأولوية للمبادرات الاستراتيجية لجامعة دار العلوم. العمل بالشراكة مع مالكي المشاريع لتحديد نطاق العمل، وتحديد المسؤولين، ووضع جداول زمنية واقعية، وميزانيات، ومقاييس نجاح. قيادة الإدارة اليومية للمشاريع المتعددة والمتزامنة عبر المجالات الأكاديمية والتشغيلية والبنية التحتية. التصدي للتأخيرات، ومتابعة الالتزامات، وإزالة العوائق أو تصعيدها للإدارة العليا، واقتراح إجراءات تصحيحية. الحفاظ على خطط شاملة للبرنامج، وسجلات للمخاطر، وسجلات للمشكلات، وأدوات تتبع المراحل الرئيسية. إعداد تقارير عالية الجودة ولوحات معلومات ومواد موجزة للقيادة العليا واللجنة التنفيذية ومجلس الإدارة. تيسير اجتماعات الحوكمة، وتتبع بنود العمل، وضمان المتابعة والإنجاز في الوقت المناسب. تحديد المخاطر والعوائق والارتباطات المتبادلة بين مسارات العمل، وتصعيدها، ودعم إيجاد حلول لها. التنسيق مع الفرق الداخلية والشركاء الخارجيين، بما في ذلك المستشارون القانونيون والماليون وهيئات الاعتماد. الحفاظ على معايير توثيق البرنامج وتعزيز ثقافة المساءلة المنظمة عن الإنجاز. تزويد مكتب الرئيس التنفيذي بتقارير أسبوعية موجزة ومبنية على الحقائق، وتيسير المراجعات الدورية التنفيذية للمحفظة. المساهمة في تتبع مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs) وإعداد تقارير الأداء المرتبطة بالأهداف الاستراتيجية والتجارية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في إدارة المشاريع أو مكتب إدارة المشاريع (PMO). فهم عميق لمنهجيات إدارة المشاريع وأفضل الممارسات. القدرة على قيادة فرق عمل متعددة التخصصات. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وإعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير إدارة المشاريع ضمن بيئة أكاديمية وديناميكية في جامعة دار العلوم بالرياض. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل، ويكون جزءاً من فريق يساهم في تحقيق الأهداف الاستراتيجية للجامعة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل دار العلوم للتربية والتعليم، يرجى التقديم عبر المنصات المخصصة لذلك.

ac944c2a71d1867a.description: About the Role Hilti Saudi Arabia is seeking an Account Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves managing and expanding relationships with key construction and industrial clients during the execution phase of major projects. The Account Manager will serve as a strategic partner, integrating Hilti’s solutions into ongoing projects to drive value, efficiency, and customer loyalty. Key Responsibilities Manage and nurture relationships with key stakeholders, including contractors, engineers, and procurement teams, across assigned projects. Ensure effective implementation of Hilti products, software, and services during the mid-phase of construction projects. Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within ongoing projects to maximize share of wallet. Provide technical consultation and product demonstrations to address project-specific challenges. Coordinate with internal teams, including engineering, logistics, marketing, and customer service, to ensure seamless project delivery. Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer feedback to inform strategic decisions. Maintain accurate records of project progress, sales activities, and forecasts using CRM tools. The role requires a professional who can effectively manage client relationships and drive business development within ongoing projects. Opportunities for international mobility and career advancement. The company is committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an inclusive environment where every voice is valued, and every team member feels empowered to contribute. This foundation strengthens teams, innovation, and overall impact.

acb9206b3e34195f.description: تعلن الشركة عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى الشركة. المتطلبات: • سعودي الجنسية. • بكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية. • حديث التخرج. • لديه عضوية سارية في الهيئة السعودية للمهندسين. • الجدية والالتزام والرغبة في التطور والتعلم.

ac3ac6a42bb7dda1.description: About the Role Complete Growth is seeking an Odoo Functional Consultant and Implementer to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This is a full-time position for professionals with 2-5 years of experience in Odoo implementation and functional consulting. Role Overview The Odoo Functional Consultant and Implementer will be responsible for the successful deployment and configuration of Odoo modules, ensuring they align with client business requirements. This role involves direct interaction with clients and technical teams to translate business needs into effective Odoo solutions. Key Responsibilities Implement and configure Odoo modules based on specific client business needs. Act as a liaison between clients and the technical team to accurately translate business requirements into functional solutions. Provide comprehensive training and ongoing support to end-users. Troubleshoot functional issues within Odoo and propose process improvements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in Odoo functional consulting and implementation. Demonstrated ability to configure Odoo modules to meet diverse business needs. Experience in client communication and requirements gathering. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, with Complete Growth. The role involves working closely with both clients and internal technical teams. Application Process The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

ac64003146ad5bbb.description: About Red Sea Coastal Trading Company Red Sea Coastal Trading Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in supply chain and logistics. The company supports pioneering developments by ensuring the delivery of materials, equipment, and services. It operates within Saudi Arabia's regenerative tourism projects, providing end-to-end supply chain management, including procurement, transportation, inventory, warehouse management, and last-mile logistics to remote locations across the Red Sea coast and beyond. The company emphasizes efficiency, reliability, and environmental responsibility, aligning with Red Sea Global’s commitment to sustainability, operational excellence, and local value creation. Job Summary The Senior Specialist Purchasing will execute purchasing activities for electrical systems and building and finishing materials. This full-time role, based in Makkah or Jeddah, involves defining operational requirements, sourcing, negotiating, ordering, and ensuring timely delivery. The specialist will support supplier and contract management, market and demand analysis, SAP material creation, purchase order follow-up, discrepancy resolution, accurate documentation, policy compliance, and timely reporting to meet cost, quality, and service objectives. Key Responsibilities Manage and execute purchasing strategies. Track and report key functional metrics to reduce expenses and improve effectiveness. Partner with stakeholders to ensure clear requirements documentation. Forecast price and market trends to identify changes in buyer-supplier power. Seek and partner with reliable vendors and suppliers. Monitor and forecast upcoming levels of demand. Communicate with hotel and operator engineering teams for technical request aspects. Establish contracts to ensure negotiated prices for all operating items required for hotels. Ensure that all order receiving dates are updated by buyers according to supplier delivery dates. Ensure that all authorized or approved purchase orders are sent to respective suppliers/vendors daily. Ensure and verify that quotations are regularly updated and supplier current price lists are maintained. Research and identify new products and services for hotels in the market. Check, explain if needed, and approve delivered items discrepancy reports issued by cost control regarding price and quantity order variances. Perform material creation on SAP, ensuring correct material details (Description, UOM, Sizing, Brand, and COO). Verify the 'pending orders' report daily, ensuring all pending orders are checked and verified regularly. Identify items for standing orders utilizing vendor logistics for regular deliveries to hotels based on approved highly consumed items. Ensure validity of available items, force issue obsolete items, and follow up on disposal actions. Verify that all documentation and proper quotations are maintained and filed according to Policy and Procedure requirements. Ensure the efficient operation of the Purchasing Department in all aspects. Submit reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 3 years of experience in the procurement of Electrical Systems or Building and Finishing Materials for construction projects. Experience range: 2-5 years. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in the Makkah region, with operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role may require a flexible schedule to accomplish all major responsibilities and tasks.

ac99c3d80c9dd419.description: About the Role W Hotels is seeking an Assistant Director of EBC to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves supporting the segmented sales efforts, including group, transient, association, and corporate segments. The role focuses on implementing sales strategies, achieving revenue goals, and ensuring guest and employee satisfaction. The Assistant Director will conduct daily sales activities with an emphasis on building long-term, value-based customer relationships. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with sales leadership to understand and effectively implement sales strategies for assigned segments. Assist in developing, implementing, and sustaining aggressive solicitation programs to increase business. Work with the management team to create and implement a sales plan addressing revenue, customers, and market dynamics. Support the development and implementation of internal and external promotions. Provide leadership to maximize revenue potential, including setting personal booking goals. Participate in sales calls to acquire new business and close deals. Execute operational aspects of booked business, such as generating proposals, writing contracts, and managing customer correspondence. Sales Analysis and Reporting Analyze market information using sales systems and implement strategies to achieve financial room and catering goals. Assist Revenue Management in completing accurate six-period projections. Review sales and catering guest satisfaction results to identify areas for improvement. Customer Service and Relationship Management Demonstrate leadership in guest hospitality and customer service, setting a positive example for guest relations. Interact with guests to gather feedback on product quality and service levels. Meet with guests during pre- and post-convention meetings to obtain feedback on product quality, service levels, contract execution, and overall satisfaction. Ensure a customer recognition program is active throughout the Sales department. Execute and support the company’s Customer Service Standards and property’s Brand Standards. Build and manage relationships with key internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate with off-property sales channels, including the Event Booking Center, Market Sales, and GSO, to ensure property needs are met and sales efforts are complementary. Qualifications and Experience Experience: 2-5 years in a relevant sales role. Demonstrated ability to achieve personal booking goals. Proficiency in analyzing market information and implementing sales strategies. Strong customer service and relationship-building skills. The role requires active participation in customer events, trade shows, and sales missions to maintain and develop key relationships.

acbd64462d87e465.company_name: Solaiman A. ElKhereiji (SAK) Engineering Consultant Company
acbd64462d87e465.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a Design Manager (Landscape) to oversee and manage all landscape design activities across various projects. This full-time role operates within a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) environment, focusing on ensuring designs align with client requirements, project objectives, and regulatory standards. The position requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Role Overview The Design Manager (Landscape) acts as the client representative for landscape design oversight. This involves a primary focus on review, governance, integration, and delivery assurance, rather than being the primary designer. The core responsibility is to ensure that consultants deliver coordinated, buildable, and compliant landscape designs that meet high-quality, sustainable, and integrated solutions. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage all landscape design activities from concept through detailed design and construction support. Coordinate landscape design with multidisciplinary teams including architectural, civil, utilities, infrastructure, and MEP. Review and validate landscape design submissions from consultants for compliance with project scope, quality standards, and regulations. Ensure design integration across disciplines through regular design reviews and clash detection processes. Develop, monitor, and manage the landscape design program aligned with overall project timelines. Provide expert input on landscape design, covering planting strategies, irrigation, grading, drainage, and hardscape. Review landscape concepts for functionality, sustainability, and aesthetic quality, ensuring the use of appropriate plant species (native, climate-appropriate, low-maintenance). Assess environmental impact, soil conditions, hydrology, and long-term maintainability of proposed designs. Verify implementation of sustainable design solutions, including water efficiency and green infrastructure. Liaise with clients, authorities, and stakeholders for design approvals and compliance. Participate in technical meetings with consultants and contractors to resolve design issues. Support project reporting by providing updates on landscape design progress and risks. Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost, schedule, and quality. Support value engineering exercises for landscape elements without compromising quality. Identify and mitigate design-related risks and technical challenges. Provide technical support during construction phases, including responding to RFIs and reviewing shop drawings. Oversee landscape implementation to ensure design intent is maintained. Monitor site progress related to landscaping and coordinate with supervision teams. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in landscape design and management. Proven ability to manage landscape design activities from concept through construction support. Experience in a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) environment is preferred. Strong technical knowledge in planting strategies, irrigation, grading, drainage, and hardscape. Demonstrated understanding of sustainable design solutions and environmental impact assessment. Work Type This is a full-time position.

ac00db6fbb79fc0f.description: About the Role Nexttec Technology Outsourcing is seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion SCM Consultant to join a client team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves implementing, configuring, and optimizing Oracle Fusion Supply Chain Management solutions to meet specific client requirements. The consultant will work within a dynamic environment, contributing to the successful deployment and ongoing support of SCM applications. Role Overview The Oracle Fusion SCM Consultant will be responsible for the full lifecycle of SCM solution implementation, from initial client engagement and requirements gathering to system testing, user training, and ongoing support. This position requires a strong understanding of supply chain processes and proficiency with Oracle Fusion applications to deliver effective solutions. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with clients to understand their business processes and supply chain management requirements. Design and configure Oracle Fusion SCM modules, including Inventory, Order Management, Procurement, and Logistics. Conduct system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and provide comprehensive training to end-users. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Oracle Fusion SCM applications. Develop documentation for system configurations, processes, and user guides. Stay updated on the latest Oracle Fusion SCM features and industry best practices. Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with other Oracle modules and third-party applications. Provide ongoing support and enhancements to existing SCM solutions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3 years of experience as an Oracle Fusion SCM Consultant. Demonstrated experience with Oracle Fusion applications. Solid understanding of supply chain processes. Required Skills Strong analytical skills to assess business requirements and design effective solutions. Excellent problem-solving abilities for troubleshooting and issue resolution. Effective communication skills to interact with stakeholders at all levels. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

ac3a2c50ef943d7b.description: About the Role Misk Schools is seeking an Associate Teacher to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of experience. The Associate Teacher is primarily responsible for supporting student education, ensuring high standards of work and conduct, and assisting teachers with educational programs. A key focus of this role is safeguarding and promoting the well-being of all students, adhering to the school's statutory policies. Key Responsibilities Establish and maintain a safe and stimulating environment for students. Prepare classroom materials and supplies, such as bulletin boards and duplicated materials, as directed by the teacher. Support teachers through small group or whole class instruction. Effectively use translanguaging strategies to maintain bilingualism across the curriculum. Provide cover for lessons, CCAPs, and duties when required. Monitor the physical and emotional well-being of pupils and respond appropriately to situations. Implement emergency and evacuation procedures as required. Ensure full awareness of the school's health and safety policies. Attend and participate in training days, weekly staff meetings, and other meetings as required. Supervise playtimes and lunchtimes when necessary. Promote subjects within the school and provide co-curricular opportunities. Work collaboratively with teachers and the wider school team. Provide support inside and outside the classroom, including during camps, educational visits, and whole-school activities, to ensure full student participation. Perform other delegated duties and accountabilities, including mutually agreed objectives. Support the teacher in no more than 25 lessons per week, as directed by the Junior School Principal. Undertake additional duties as required by the line manager. Safeguarding Responsibilities The Associate Teacher is required to safeguard and promote the welfare of children and young people, adhering to the school's safeguarding policies and staff code of conduct. This role involves direct support to the Designated Safeguarding Lead as a priority to ensure the safety and well-being of all students. Experience and Work Type This full-time position requires candidates to have 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

ac4654a83e03ee4e.company_name: SAMA Holding Co- SAMA Construction C.J.S
ac4654a83e03ee4e.description: About The Luxury Collection The Luxury Collection is seeking a Director of Operations to lead hotel operations in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves strategic leadership across various departments to ensure operational excellence and achieve business objectives. Role Summary The Director of Operations functions as the strategic business leader for the property's hotel operations, which may include Front Office, Recreation/Health Club, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage/Culinary, and Engineering/Maintenance. This position works with department heads to develop and implement departmental strategies, ensuring alignment with the brand service strategy and initiatives. The role focuses on meeting brand standards, addressing customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, growing revenues, maximizing financial performance, and fostering positive owner relations. The Director develops and implements property-wide strategies to deliver products and services that meet or exceed customer and employee expectations and provide a return on investment. Key Responsibilities Demonstrate and communicate key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer. Analyze service issues and identify trends to make informed decisions. Collaborate with the hotel management team to develop and execute an operational strategy aligned with the brand’s business strategy. Monitor hotel operations sales performance against budget and review financial statements. Coach and support the operations team in managing occupancy, rate, wages, and controllable expenses. Review Wage Progress Reports, compare budgeted to actual wages, and address problem areas with direct reports. Champion the brand’s service vision and ensure alignment among hotel leadership teams. Develop systems to help employees understand guest satisfaction results and communicate departmental goals clearly. Review guest feedback with the leadership team and ensure appropriate corrective actions are taken. Respond to and resolve guest problems and complaints, maintaining visibility and interacting with customers regularly. Create an atmosphere in all Rooms and Food and Beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations. Human Resources Management Facilitate the development and implementation of creative solutions to improve guest satisfaction. Ensure fair and equitable treatment of employees and consistent communication within Operations. Foster employee commitment to excellent service, participate in daily stand-up meetings, and model desired service behaviors. Incorporate guest satisfaction into staff meetings, focusing on innovative improvement strategies. Set goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and hold staff accountable. Solicit employee feedback, maintain an open-door policy, and review employee satisfaction results to address concerns. Ensure property policies are administered fairly and consistently, and disciplinary procedures adhere to SOPs and LSOPs. Conduct annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures. Champion change, ensure brand and regional business initiatives are implemented, and communicate follow-up actions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in hotel operations leadership. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic operational plans. Strong financial acumen with experience in managing budgets and driving revenue. Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage and motivate diverse teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for guest, employee, and owner relations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring a leader who can thrive in a dynamic luxury hospitality environment.

ac8672c8b605e2cc.description: Job Summary كيلوج براون اند روت is seeking a Project Control Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves contributing to a major infrastructure program for a mixed-use development, aiming to establish a global landmark in Riyadh known for its unique vision and authentic destination status. The community will function as a distinct, self-sustaining hub within Riyadh, featuring several iconic assets. KBR's involvement includes providing PMO services, enterprise-level governance, assurance, integration, and performance oversight across all projects and programs. Role Overview Reporting to the Project Controls Director, the Project Control Manager is responsible for maintaining, governing, implementing, and providing pre and post-contract implementation governance. This includes managing the suite of Project Controls policies, management plans, standards, procedures, and processes, all in support of reporting requirements and systems such as Aconex, Unifier, and P6. The role requires regular review and updates of existing governance documents on a quarterly or annual basis. Key Responsibilities Onboard and train PMCs to facilitate understanding of the Programme, policies, processes, and associated project management information systems and applications. Maintain, implement, and administer the PMC onboarding process and welcome pack documents, continuously updating the PMC onboarding tracker. Maintain and implement the Project Controls governance structure, including roles and responsibilities (RACI) across all downstream levels. Review the existing structure, propose improvements, and align with required updates/changes. Maintain, review, and update all Reporting Governance Documents, including management plans, manuals, guidelines, and templates. Develop, implement, and administer a comprehensive program meeting and reporting calendar for assigned Districts/Master Plans. Manage and maintain the PMIS-driven business intelligence (BI) reporting platform, including preparing and creating new BI dashboards and data entry registers through approved systems (*, SharePoint, Unifier). Compile data from PMCs for standardized weekly, monthly, and executive-level dashboards. Perform project-level performance reporting for schedule, cost, risk, procurement, OHSE, and change management. Ensure consistent data definitions, KPIs, and red-amber-green (RAG) criteria across all reports. Assist with the preparation of training material for PMCs on the use of implemented systems and data population. Provide support to the client's Project Controls Team for related PMIS and Data Warehouse (DWH) requirements. Maintain, implement, and administer a process for tracking and monitoring PMC performance against agreed KPIs, producing a monthly report highlighting performance and required corrective actions. Update the status of corrective actions during subsequent reporting cycles. Assess existing monitoring systems and propose enhancements and improvements to the overall process. Ensure PMC reporting schedules are consistent with PMO executive report preparation. Review and collate District/Master Plan programs to produce and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS). Establish and implement Project Controls Compliance Audit Requirements and conduct regular PMC audits to ensure adherence to standards and policies. Implement processes and systems to monitor timely completion of Stage Gate Reviews and reporting across assigned Districts/Master Plans, highlighting issues and/or risks impacting program delivery. Maintain and issue the "KPI's Report" monthly, highlighting key areas of concern with corrective measures and mitigation. Produce a "Key Actions Required" report and escalation process for executive management. Prepare the monthly Programme Status Report, highlighting overall program, district, and individual project status and progress, including status against approved dates, schedule alerts, and key issues. Manage and update the existing Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) with updates recorded in the WBS change register. Maintain an updated mapping tracker between WBS, CBS, and SAP projects. Prepare monthly Programme Level Status Reports. Prepare required inputs for Executive Reports, including program and commercial update information and program "asks" requirements. Develop and implement a Value Engineering Management plan, process, and templates, with communication and training provided to PMCs to record savings against the Budget (Total Development Cost). Develop and maintain a standardized Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) across all programs and projects to ensure consistent cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting, aligning CBS, WBS, work packages, procurement strategies, and budgeting requirements. Develop and maintain a structured Work Package Identification framework to ensure all project scope is clearly defined, consistently structured, and effectively aligned with planning, cost, procurement, and delivery. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project control management or a related field. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

acfb141c47545deb.description: About the Role SANY Saudi Arabia is seeking a Training Service Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on delivering specialized training for SANY equipment. Role Overview The Training Service Engineer will be responsible for developing and conducting professional training programs for various types of SANY machinery. This role involves creating comprehensive training materials and providing both internal and external technical and operational support. Key Responsibilities Conduct professional training sessions on pumping, hoisting, and rotary drilling equipment. Develop and implement annual regional training plans for assigned products. Prepare, develop, and regularly update training materials, operation manuals, maintenance case studies, examination question banks, and practical operation guidelines. Provide on-site training for key accounts, new equipment delivery training, and customized customer training programs. Support customers and internal teams by delivering technical and operational training related to SANY equipment. Candidate Profile Possess strong communication, presentation, and training skills. Willingness to travel within Saudi Arabia as required for training delivery. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and may involve travel across the region. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity.

ac35aa3c65fdc873.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في ضبا، تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال صيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. فهم جيد لمكونات أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف ومبادئ عملها. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والرسومات الهندسية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية قوية في استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل سيعمل الفني في مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بمنفذ ضباء، مما يتطلب الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية للمشروع والمعايير التشغيلية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في منطقة تبوك، مدينة ضبا. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

ac7f434f6257b13b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في مدينتي قرية العليا والقريات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني التمديدات الكهربائية مسؤولية دراسة المخططات، تقدير المواد، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، بالإضافة إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة. تشمل المهام الأساسية ما يلي: دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف المنشآت (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية المطلوبة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة سير أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية المناسبة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية المختلفة. معرفة قوية بتقدير الكميات والمواصفات الفنية للمواد والأجهزة الكهربائية. إتقان إجراء فحوصات التمديدات الكهربائية وتشخيص الأعطال. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات فنية ممتازة في تركيب وصيانة التمديدات الكهربائية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التمديدات الكهربائية بدوام كامل في مواقع العمل المختلفة ضمن منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. يتطلب الدور تطبيقاً صارماً لإجراءات السلامة المهنية في جميع الأوقات. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا الدور. على المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة المهنية في سراكو.

aca519bc7390307f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مواسم العلم التجارية عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في أحد رفيده، بمنطقة عسير. يمثل هذا الدور فرصة للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة أو بدون خبرة سابقة، حيث يتطلب من 0 إلى 1 سنة من الخبرة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمهام إدخال البيانات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدخال البيانات والمعلومات بدقة في أنظمة الحاسب الآلي المعتمدة في المؤسسة. تخزين البيانات والمعلومات بشكل منظم على أجهزة الحاسب الآلي. تنفيذ الخدمات الإلكترونية المختلفة باستخدام الحاسب الآلي. إدخال بيانات المبيعات والمشتريات في النظام الآلي الخاص بالمؤسسة. إجراء عمليات الجرد الآلي عند الحاجة أو الطلب. مراجعة وتصحيح الأخطاء في رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة. ضمان تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بشكل آمن ومنظم. عمل النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة للحفاظ عليها. الالتزام التام بالتعليمات والإرشادات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدخال البيانات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إدخال البيانات. القدرة على استخدام برامج الحاسب الآلي وأنظمة إدخال البيانات. الالتزام بالتعليمات والسياسات الداخلية للمؤسسة. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في أحد رفيده، عسير، وتوفر المؤسسة بيئة عمل منظمة تدعم إنجاز المهام بكفاءة. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب التواجد المنتظم في مقر المؤسسة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

acfdf96ddd8e5702.description: About the Role Dussmann Ajlan & Bros is seeking a Hard Service Consultant to join the team at its Headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. acfe98b3c49e839e.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز كلودينزا للتزيين النسائي عن مدير عمليات تشغيل للانضمام إلى فريقه في مدينة الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية الإشراف المباشر على تخطيط وتنظيم عمليات التشغيل لضمان أعلى مستويات الكفاءة والفعالية. يمثل هذا الدور فرصة للمحترفين ذوي الخبرة في إدارة العمليات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. الغرض من الوظيفة يشارك مدير عمليات التشغيل في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية لعمليات التشغيل، ويضمن توافر جميع الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات بكفاءة. يهدف الدور إلى متابعة تنفيذ التعليمات المختلفة بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية المحددة، والمساهمة في تحقيق الأهداف العامة للمركز. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والأهداف العامة بما يتماشى مع التوجهات والأولويات المحددة للمركز. المساهمة الفعالة في إدارة وتوجيه وتقييم عمليات التطبيق التشغيلي. متابعة وإدارة وتوجيه الأنشطة المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات، وضمان التطبيق الأمثل للأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات. متابعة عمليات إصدار التراخيص والتصاريح لضمان توافقها مع المعايير والشروط المعتمدة. المشاركة في مراجعة وتطوير الأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المتبعة في مجالات تشغيل المعدات لضمان تحديثها المستمر. مراجعة ودراسة الاحتياجات المتعلقة بالمعدات. متابعة عمليات إعداد وتحضير تقارير العمل والإنجاز، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا المتخصصة. إحاطة الإدارة العليا بالتحديات والمستجدات المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بعمليات التشغيل. القدرة على إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات ممتازة في إدارة وتوجيه الفرق والأنشطة التشغيلية. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير عمليات التشغيل بدوام كامل في مركز كلودينزا للتزيين النسائي بالخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع الإدارة العليا والفرق التشغيلية لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرات.

ac58174a698700f0.description: We are looking for qualified Firefighters to join our client’s emergency response team in the Eastern Province. The role involves responding to fire and emergency incidents, operating firefighting equipment, supporting emergency preparedness activities, and ensuring the readiness of personnel and equipment in accordance with company procedures and applicable fire safety standards. Key Responsibilities Respond promptly to fire, rescue, hazardous materials, and other emergency incidents within the designated area to protect life, property, and the environment. Perform firefighting, rescue, containment, and emergency control activities using appropriate equipment and established procedures. Follow company fire protection policies, standard operating procedures, emergency response plans, and applicable Saudi fire safety requirements. Participate in scheduled emergency response drills, training exercises, and reviews or updates of Emergency Response Plans. Inspect, maintain, and ensure the operational readiness of firefighting vehicles, breathing apparatus, protective equipment, tools, and other emergency response equipment. Respond to hazardous materials incidents using appropriate personal protective equipment and established Hazmat response procedures. Coordinate with firefighters, emergency response personnel, operations teams, and relevant authorities during emergency situations. Prepare timely and accurate reports on fire incidents, emergency response activities, equipment inspections, drills, and other assigned activities. High School Diploma or Diploma in Firefighting, Fire & Safety, or a related field. Previous professional experience as a Firefighter in industrial, commercial, residential, drilling, or similar emergency response environments. NFPA 1001 – Fire Fighter I & II certification is required. NFPA 472 – Hazmat Awareness & Operations (A&O) certification is required. Good knowledge of fire emergency response, hazardous materials, technical rescue, fire prevention, and fire safety procedures. Ability to participate in emergency drills, emergency response planning, and maintain readiness of firefighting personnel and equipment. Good English proficiency. Knowledge of applicable Saudi fire safety standards and requirements. Ability to work in emergency response environments and follow safety procedures. Preferred Qualifications Experience in Oil & Gas, petrochemical, industrial, drilling, or similar high-risk environments. Experience with industrial firefighting vehicles, pumps, hoses, breathing apparatus, and rescue equipment. NFPA 1002 – Fire Apparatus Driver/Operator Professional certification is preferred for candidates assigned to Fire Apparatus Pump Operator responsibilities. Experience participating in emergency response drills and fire risk mitigation activities.

acb88f80c77dae20.description: About Diaverum Saudi Arabia Diaverum is a multinational healthcare organization originating from Sweden, dedicated to providing life-enhancing renal care to patients with chronic kidney disease. With over 15,000 employees across 25 countries, including more than 1,400 colleagues in 33 cities and towns throughout Saudi Arabia, Diaverum combines global experience with a strong local presence. The organization's vision is to transform renal care by broadening access to high-quality kidney care, supported by a standardized care delivery model, evolving digital and AI capabilities, and a team committed to patient well-being. The Role of Talent Acquisition Specialist Diaverum Saudi Arabia is seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join its Human Capital team in Riyadh on a 6-month fixed-term contract. This role is crucial for supporting the recruitment team with essential administrative functions, including screening, credentialing, logistics coordination, and data management. In a growing organization where every hire directly impacts patient care, the quality and speed of the hiring process are paramount. Key Responsibilities The Talent Acquisition Specialist will support the recruitment team across three primary areas: screening and credentialing, logistics coordination, and data management. Specific responsibilities include: Supporting initial screening activities, such as resume review, screening questions, and candidate assessments based on criteria provided by the recruiter or hiring manager. Conducting reference and credentialing checks to validate candidate information, including license, certification, and qualification verification for overseas hires. Coordinating travel and logistics for overseas hiring, working directly with candidates on schedules and requirements. Supporting the onboarding of overseas hires by coordinating necessary steps with the Talent Acquisition Specialist and the candidate. Monitoring onboarding progress, documentation completion, and data accuracy across HR systems. Maintaining accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), Human Resources Information System (HRIS), and other HR systems. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple tasks and timelines concurrently. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential for interacting professionally with candidates and colleagues. The role requires a commitment to data accuracy and discretion in handling sensitive candidate information. This position is suitable for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, including fresh graduates. Required Skills and Attributes Ability to manage multiple open tasks effectively without compromising accuracy or missing deadlines. Professional communication skills, both written and verbal, for interaction with candidates and team members. Demonstrated discretion and attention to detail when handling candidate data. Consistency in following established processes and the ability to identify and flag any gaps. Comfortable working independently within a fast-paced hiring environment. Impact of the Role This focused, high-impact fixed-term role offers direct exposure to recruitment operations within a growing healthcare organization. The Talent Acquisition Specialist plays a vital role in ensuring the hiring process moves accurately and professionally, directly influencing how quickly qualified individuals join Diaverum's teams and how smoothly they transition into the organization. Diaverum has a clear mission and a long-term presence in Saudi Arabia. We encourage all qualifying candidates, including fresh graduates, to apply.

ac37131a295dc0c7.description: At SIHAMCO, our culinary teams are at the heart of every exceptional guest experience. If you are passionate about food, committed to excellence, and eager to grow your culinary career, we invite you to join us. We are looking for passionate, disciplined, and talented Commis I and Commis II chefs to join our culinary team. Working alongside experienced chefs, you will play an essential role in preparing high-quality dishes while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen organization. Job Summary As a Commis I / Commis II, you will support the Back of House team in food preparation, mise en place, and daily kitchen operations. You will be responsible for producing dishes to recipe and presentation standards while developing your culinary skills in a fast-paced, premium dining environment. Key Responsibilities Prepare ingredients and mise en place according to recipes and chef instructions. Assist in the preparation and cooking of menu items while maintaining consistency and quality. Ensure all dishes are presented to brand standards before leaving the kitchen. Maintain cleanliness and organization of your assigned section throughout service. Follow recipes, portion controls, and food presentation guidelines. Ensure proper storage, labelling, and rotation of food products using FIFO (First In, First Out) principles. Monitor food quality and report shortages or quality concerns to the Chef de Partie or Sous Chef. Maintain excellent food hygiene and sanitation standards in compliance with HACCP requirements. Operate kitchen equipment safely and report any faults or maintenance issues. Assist with receiving, checking, and storing deliveries. Minimize food waste and contribute to effective stock control. Work collaboratively with chefs and kitchen colleagues to deliver smooth and efficient service. Participate in training sessions and continuously develop culinary skills. Support opening, closing, and deep-cleaning duties as required. Previous experience in a pastry kitchen is preferred but not essential. Culinary or pastry qualification is an advantage. Basic knowledge of pastry preparation and baking techniques. Passion for pastry, baking and dessert production. Willingness to learn and develop professionally. Good attention to detail. Ability to follow recipes and instructions accurately. Good teamwork and communication skills. Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment. Good understanding of food hygiene and safety. Professional, reliable and well-presented. At SIHAMCO, we believe in rewarding our team with more than just a job — we offer an inspiring work environment and real opportunities for growth. Our benefits include: Competitive salary packages – aligned with market standards and experience Seasonal Visa Flights into the country for non-citizens, Return flights back home. Accommodation Transportation Career development & Internal promotions – grow with us across departments and seasons Creative & collaborative work culture – built on passion, innovation, and attention to detail Exposure to high-end hospitality & entertainment concepts – gain experience in premium F&B and entertainment Experience working on premium events Cultural diversity – join a team of passionate professionals from around the world Join us and be part of a company that’s redefining hospitality in Saudi Arabia and beyond.

ac4696e6fb33e0c2.description: About the Role Fugro is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Geotechnical Engineer to join its team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves providing geotechnical engineering services in accordance with standard practices and client specifications. Key Responsibilities Provide services in accordance with standard practices to meet client requests and contract specifications. Demonstrate a strong understanding of geotechnical methods, design practices, and Fugro procedures for engineering analysis and reporting. Study project requirements, organize, and implement appropriate techniques to develop engineering reports in consultation with Senior Engineers, Geologists, and the Engineering Manager. Assist in planning, preparing method statements, and quality plans for field investigations, and supervise field and office personnel on a project basis as instructed by a Senior Engineer. Follow up on projects and liaise with project managers or site engineers to ensure all engineering requirements are met during fieldwork, and that all field tests and sample collection comply with project specifications. Manage data from site, laboratory, and office to ensure all collected data is reported in correct formats; check borehole logs, field and lab test data, schedules, and laboratory programs for compliance with codes and practices, and obtain client approval. Discuss report structures with Senior Engineers and clients, then prepare Factual and Interpretative Engineering Reports. Develop foundation soil parameters, design assessments, engineering analyses, and prepare final reports for approval. Review and check reports and engineering analyses by others as a peer reviewer. Control the quality of work during projects. Inform Senior Engineers and the Engineering Manager to take immediate corrective action and address deviations with project team members. Provide support to Senior Engineers and Senior Engineering Geologists to obtain client approval for final reports. Act as Product Manager for selected Fugro products, gaining expertise through literature and studies, and utilizing Fugro learning portals to develop and share knowledge. Contribute actively to the implementation of published Quality Assurance, Health, Safety, and Environmental procedures in the workplace. Liaise with the Commercial Department regarding any contractual or commercial issues. QHSSE Accountabilities Ensure that Fugro policies and procedures are understood, implemented, and adhered to by all employees. Work in accordance with Fugro Procedures to achieve consistent and sustainable results. Non-conformance with processes and procedures may result in disciplinary measures. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in geotechnical engineering. Strong understanding of geotechnical methods and design practices. Proficiency in engineering analysis and reporting. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

Build trusted relationships with existing and prospective clients, such as developers, asset owners, government entities, architects, and project managers. Act as a senior adviser and point of escalation, ensuring coordinated responses across all relevant services. The successful candidate will operate within a global network of specialists, contributing to landmark projects.

ac8453d948c4b365.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Registrar Gastroenterology to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for a physician in advanced training who will provide specialized care for patients with gastrointestinal and hepatology disorders through virtual platforms. The role integrates gastroenterology clinical expertise with digital health technologies to deliver accessible, efficient, safe, and patient-centered care, while practicing under consultant supervision and in compliance with SCFHS, telemedicine regulations, and clinical governance standards. Virtual Patient Consultations and Clinical Management Assess, diagnose, and manage patients with gastrointestinal and hepatology conditions using telehealth tools (video, phone, secure messaging). Manage common GI conditions including GERD, dyspepsia, IBS, constipation, diarrhea, stable inflammatory bowel disease follow-up, fatty liver disease, hepatitis follow-up, GI-related anemia, and functional GI disorders. Review laboratory results and imaging remotely, adjusting management plans as needed. Identify red flags requiring urgent in-person assessment or hospital referral. Develop individualized treatment and monitoring plans in collaboration with consultants. Ensure accurate and timely documentation in the electronic medical record (EMR). Participate in telemedicine-driven GI care pathways, such as GERD clinics, IBS pathways, and liver disease follow-up. Professional Development and Teaching Maintain up-to-date knowledge in gastroenterology, hepatology, and digital health. Attend Continuing Medical Education (CME) activities, workshops, and conferences. Participate in case discussions and academic activities. Support the teaching and supervision of junior doctors when required. Quality Assurance, Patient Safety, and Compliance Adhere to internal medicine/gastroenterology clinical guidelines, telemedicine regulations, and ethical standards. Ensure safe prescribing practices, including dose adjustments in cases of liver impairment. Monitor and counsel patients regarding medication side effects and warning signs. Report patient safety concerns and adverse events to the Quality Department. Participate in virtual audits, quality improvement initiatives, and clinical reviews. Telehealth Platform Proficiency and Patient Experience Utilize telemedicine platforms for video consultations, secure messaging, and lab result reviews. Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential digital patient records. Participate in telehealth training and collaborate with IT support for system optimization. Communicate diagnoses and management plans clearly and empathetically. Provide education on disease progression, treatment options, and red-flag symptoms. Address patient concerns and follow-up questions promptly via telehealth channels. Encourage adherence to treatment plans and follow-up schedules. Qualifications and Requirements Experience required: 0-1 years. Ability to work effectively in a virtual healthcare environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills for patient interaction and multidisciplinary collaboration.

ace6fffa36c64ee7.job_title: Health, Safety and Environment Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
ace6fffa36c64ee7.description: Eram Talent is currently seeking a dedicated Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The HSE specialist ensures the safety and compliance of construction and projects by delivering and implementing risk-based safety programs, providing expert HSE guidance, and fostering a strong safety culture throughout the project's lifecycle. They ensure construction and project safety programs are effectively designed and executed. The role ensures a robust health and safety management system throughout the lifecycle of assigned construction and projects. The role ensures the development and execution of risk-based safety programs, performing comprehensive safety assessments, and overseeing compliance to maintain safe, healthy, and regulation-compliant environments Responsibilities Review and approve RAMS (Risk Assessments and Method Statements) to ensure the safety of personnel, property, and ongoing activities. Implement and maintain HSE management systems and project safety programs, including risk-based inspections, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory environmental, health, and safety standards through regular inspections of equipment, structures, and work activities. Lead and support incident investigations by identifying root causes, recommending corrective actions, and producing detailed reports in line with HSE procedures. Conduct regular safety meetings, training sessions, and Toolbox Talks to promote awareness and reinforce a strong safety culture. Monitor and analyze HSE performance metrics (KPIs), providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve safety strategies and program effectiveness. Perform audits and risk-based inspections to ensure compliance, track corrective actions, and verify effective mitigation of identified hazards. Review critical documentation such as safety plans, permits to work, lifting plans, MOCs, and design documents to ensure alignment with HSE requirements. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders, ensuring lessons learned are shared and corrective measures are properly implemented. Support overall project lifecycle activities, including site inspections, safety training delivery, regulatory compliance, and adherence to HSE policies, while demonstrating strong reporting, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills. Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field. Minimum of 8 years’ experience in construction safety or HSE roles within large-scale projects. Experience working with Integrated Management Systems (IMS), including ISO standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001). Certified ISO 45001:2018 Lead Auditor qualification is required. Proven competency in Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis techniques. Recognized professional HSE certification such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST) is preferred. Internationally recognized certification such as NEBOSH Certificate or Diploma is highly desirable. Certified First Aid qualification is preferred. Valid driver’s license is required. Strong practical knowledge of construction safety practices, risk management, and regulatory compliance in international environments. Strong commitment to promoting safety culture and environmental sustainability.
